importProducts.title: Import Products from CSV
importProducts.subtitle: Add many products at once from a CSV file (e.g. an export from Excel or your till).
importProducts.uploadDescription: Each row in the file becomes one product.
importProducts.noFile: Choose a CSV file to import.
importProducts.formatColumns: The first row holds the column names; description is the only optional column.
importProducts.formatSeparator: Columns can be separated by commas or semicolons, and decimals can use a point or a comma.
importProducts.formatDate: Expiry date e.g. 31.12.2026, 31/12/2026 or 2026-12-31; the formats Excel writes on its own are recognized too. If a date still fails, format the date column as Text in Excel.
importProducts.formatAllOrNothing: If any row has an error, nothing is imported. Fix the file and send it again.
